messages:
Alice Chen: quick heads up — I'm kicking off a short sync on measurable signals for the KV/prefix cache observability work. goal: a minimal, low-cardinality set we can ship to dashboards and alerts this quarter.
Ben Ortiz: +1. can we include both absolute hit_rate and a workload-weighted hit_rate? ops wants something that reflects customer impact, not just global ratio.
Dimitri Pavlov: yes to both. suggestion: hit_rate = hits / (hits + misses) (per-shard), weighted_hit = sum(hits * qps_sample)/sum((hits+misses) * qps_sample) where qps_sample is sampled request frequency per workload.
Maya Singh: real quick question — how do we tag "workload"? model+route? tenant? we need to keep cardinality bounded.
Alice Chen: keep workload = model_name || ':' || route_kind (eg "llama2:chat"). no tenant tagging by default — can add tenant only for enterprise dashboards behind a filter.
Zoe Park: evictions: we should record evictions/sec and eviction_reason (memory_pressure|ttl|manual). but eviction_reason is high-cardinity; propose only memory_pressure vs other.
Ben Ortiz: +1 on simplified reasons. also capture reuse_by_prefix: number of times a cached prefix was reused for different requests in a minute window. KPI: reuse_count / total_requests for that prefix length bucket.
Dimitri Pavlov: telemetry ingest note: please emit metrics as counters/gauges — no high-res logs. proto names: rwi_kv_hits_total, rwi_kv_misses_total, rwi_kv_evictions_total, rwi_kv_reuse_total, rwi_kv_reuse_by_workload. tags: shard, region, model_route, prefix_len_bucket.
Maya Singh: prefix_len_bucket? ranges like 0-8,9-32,33-128,129+. keep 4 buckets to avoid explosion.
Alice Chen: agreed. also include sample_rate tag when we downsample workloads (e.g., sample_rate=0.01) so dashboard math can scale up.
sre-bot: NOTE: new metric family rwi_kv_* created in telemetry proto. collectors will start ingesting when agents pick up the rollout.
Zoe Park: small PR idea for runtime: emit reuse events only for prefixes that cross a reuse_threshold (>=2 reuse) to reduce cardinality noise. we can toggle via feature flag.
Dimitri Pavlov: rolling ingestion plan: stage 1 (1 week) — shard-level hit/miss/eviction counters + prefix_len buckets. stage 2 (2 weeks) — workload-weighted and reuse_by_workload. stage 3 — alerts and dashboards.
Ben Ortiz: dashboard owner volunteers? I'll own the ops dashboard (SLO-level views + alert thresholds). Alice can own product-facing console widgets.
Alice Chen: I can do console widget design, will draft wireframes and attach to this thread.
Maya Singh: performance question — will these counters add measurable overhead on hot paths? keep increments as atomic counters, avoid costly tags on the hot path.
Dimitri Pavlov: good call. runtime will batch metrics flush and avoid string allocs by using enum ids for tags at runtime. expect <2% CPU on p99 workloads.
Ben Ortiz: open TODOs: 1) finalize proto names & tags (Dimitri) 2) wireframe for console (Alice) 3) ops dashboard + initial alerts (Ben) 4) perf microbenchmark (Maya) 5) rollout plan and feature flag (Zoe). ETA: propose end-of-next-sprint for stage1.
Alice Chen: thanks all — I'll capture PR links and assign owners. leaving this here for async folks. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Coordination thread to define low-cardinality KV/prefix cache metrics (hits, misses, evictions, reuse_by_workload), tagging strategy (model_route, prefix_len_bucket), ingestion stages, instrumentation tradeoffs, owners and rollout plan.
